key_claims.claim: After PGT-A euploid embryo transfer, cfDNA screening has a positive predictive value of only 12.5 percent for aneuploidy, with confirmed aneuploidy at amniocentesis in 0.1 percent and clinically relevant CMA findings in 0.5 percent overall.

Approximately 30 percent of fetal intracranial hemorrhage cases have an identifiable genetic etiology, and a structured neurosonography workflow can guide parental counseling on neurodevelopmental outcomes.
In closed spinal dysraphism, limited dorsal myeloschisis is the dominant prenatal finding, and postnatal functional outcomes at 18 and 36 months can be characterized from multicenter cohort data.
A new multivariable predictive model for prenatal coarctation diagnosis outperforms any single sagittal aortic-arch parameter on external multicenter validation.
In bilateral renal agenesis treated with serial amnioinfusions, decreased fetal pulmonary artery pulsatility index on hyperoxia testing correlates with favorable 30-day respiratory outcomes.
